title: [Shopify] Disable Create Sales Documents for empty order views
summary: The Create Sales Documents action on the Shopify Orders page is now disabled when the current filtered view contains no orders, preventing users from attempting to create documents with no data.
key_points: Action state updates dynamically based on active record filters
Disabled when filtered view is empty, enabled when orders are present
Standard list lookup behavior is preserved
Test coverage added for filtered views with orders, no orders, and orders again
No breaking changes or new analyzer warnings
quote: Disable Create Sales Documents on the Shopify Orders page when the current filtered view contains no orders.
